answers.explanation: The control plane moves to a central controller. The switches keep only the data plane.
All the decisions, including ACLs, come down from the controller.
OpenFlow is the classic southbound API.
Northbound faces the apps above. Southbound faces the switches below.
Flow table entries say what to do with packets that match a pattern.
Source, destination, ports, protocol, VLAN: a flow rule can use any of them.
Like a hypervisor, whoever owns it owns everything below it.
